name: qwen-code
description: An open-source AI coding agent that lives in your terminal.
one_liner: A free, open-source AI coding assistant that lives in your terminal, editor, or chat — a no-subscription alternative to closed coding-agent products.
buyer: A budget-conscious freelance developer or small dev team that wants a capable terminal coding agent without paying per-seat SaaS fees to a closed competitor.
business_use_cases: A freelance developer uses it with a cheaper or open model to keep client project costs down when API pricing from closed competitors is painful.
A dev-tools consultancy offers 'bring your own coding agent' setup services, installing and configuring it for clients who want to avoid vendor lock-in.
An engineering team builds internal integrations on its open architecture instead of being boxed in by a closed, proprietary agent.

money_ideas.idea: A paid setup and consulting package that configures it with a company's preferred model and internal tools
A managed, hosted version with shared team config and billing roll-up

steal_this: Offer a flat-fee 'migrate your team off per-seat coding-agent subscriptions' setup gig using it as the replacement.
